text: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the chairman of the drafting committee and is widely recognized as the Father of the Indian Constitution.

text: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet because of the iron oxide (rust) on its surface, which gives it a reddish appearance.

text: What is the capital city of Japan?
explanation: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan.

text: Which is the largest desert in the world (including polar regions)?
explanation: The Antarctic Desert is the largest desert in the world. Deserts are defined by low precipitation, not just sand and heat.
